title: 莫德凯撒·迷你小花园
description: 深铁甲莫德凯撒保留高角盔与青绿眼光，在桌前轻放一株小盆栽，巨锤安稳陈列。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Mordekaiser is an enormous fully armored figure with dark iron plates, a tall horned helmet, glowing teal visor openings, broad angular shoulders, and a heavy cape-like metal silhouette. Preserve the recognizable closed armor rather than exposing a human face or skeletal remains. His massive spiked mace rests securely in a low reinforced cradle, with softened crayon points and no threatening raised pose.
art_direction.scene: He sits at a very sturdy little table and carefully lowers a tiny potted fern onto a round coaster using both huge gauntlets. A small watering cup beside it creates a gentle scale contrast. Keep the room bright and uncluttered, with the mace motionless behind the chair and no ghosts, battle debris, or frightening shadows.
art_direction.palette: charcoal iron, soft teal, fern green, warm ivory
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
